headline: S&P Global Ratings Projects Malaysia GDP Growth to Moderate to 5.1%
summary: Malaysia's economic growth is projected to slow to 5.1% in 2027 from 5.5% this year, according to a revised outlook by S&P Global Ratings.
why: Malaysia's export-reliant economy provides insight into semiconductor supply chains and commodities demand across ASEAN.

impacts.name: Malaysia
impacts.why: S&P Global Ratings expects GDP growth to moderate from 5.5% to 5.1% in 2027.
